pickups.name: Big Coin Bag
pickups.description:
Big Coin Bag is a pickup item that increases the player's Gold Coins by 25, multiplied by the Greed stat.
Unlike most pickups, such as Coin Bag and Rich Coin Bag, this pickup is not obtained by killing enemies or by destroying light sources. Instead, it is obtained as one of the two options in the level up menu if the player has maxed out the levels of all of the weapons and passives in their possession, assuming that Limit Break is disabled. However, it is still possible to obtain Big Coin Bags through some 3- or 5-item treasure chests even with Limit Break, though one of the items from the treasure chest would be a Super Candybox II Turbo.
pickups.effects: Gives 25 Coins.
pickups.notes:
* Obtained after maxing out the levels of all weapons and passives though leveling up with Limit Break disabled.
* Amount of coins gained is multiplied by Greed.

pickups.name: Cheese
pickups.description:
Cheese is a pickup item in Vampire Survivors. It spawns in Dairy Plant after collecting Yellow Sign. It is visible on the map as a Floor Chicken.
Upon collecting the Cheese, seven large Werewolves will spawn in a circle around the player; defeating all of them unlocks Minnah Mannarah as a playable character.
pickups.effects: Heals 30 HP, summons werewolves.

pickups.name: Coin Bag
pickups.caption: Adds 10 to your Gold coins total.
pickups.description:
Coin Bag is an item pickup that increases your Gold Coin total by 10, multiplied by the Greed stat. It can drop from destroyed light sources.
It can trigger a Gold Fever when Disco of Gold (XV) is selected.
pickups.effects: Gives 10 Coins.
pickups.notes:
* Amount of coins gained is multiplied by Greed.
* Triggers Gold Fever with Disco of Gold active.

pickups.name: Corn
pickups.description: Corn is a pickup item in Vampire Survivors. Its only use is as an easter egg spawned in Green Acres after entering the spell "popthecorn".
pickups.effects: Heals 30 HP.

pickups.name: Crystallized Soul
pickups.caption: Pick up to get a minor bonus to MaxHealth, Recovery, and Growth.
pickups.description:
The Crystallized Soul is a pickup item in Vampire Survivors. It is dropped by defeating frozen enemies while Crystal Cries (XII) is active.
The stat bonuses provided by a Crystallized Soul are based on the Base XP value of the enemy that dropped it:
* Max Health = 0.06 * Base XP
* Recovery = 0.0003 * Base XP
* Growth = 0.03% * Base XP
For example, a Skelegem, with a Base XP of 3, will drop a Crystallized Soul that gives +0.18 Max Health, +0.0009 Recovery, and +0.09% Growth.
pickups.effects: Increases Max Health, Recovery, and Growth by a minuscule amount, which is multiplied by the Base XP value of the enemy that dropped it.

pickups.name: Cursed Soul
pickups.caption: Pick up to get a minor bonus to MaxHealth, Greed, and Curse.
pickups.description:
The Cursed Soul is a pickup item in Vampire Survivors. It is dropped by defeating enemies with Insatiable or Cursed World Eater provided by Victorian Horror (XVIII).
The stat bonuses provided by a Cursed Soul are based on the Base XP value of the enemy that dropped it:
* Max Health = 0.1 * Base XP
* Greed = 0.05% * Base XP
* Curse = 0.05% * Base XP
For example, a Skelegem, with a Base XP of 3, will drop a Cursed Soul that grants +0.3 Max Health, +0.15% Greed, and +0.15% Curse.
pickups.effects: Increases Max Health, Greed, and Curse by a minuscule amount that is multiplied by the Base XP Value of the enemy that dropped it.

pickups.name: Experience Gem
pickups.caption: Increases experience.
pickups.description: Experience Gems are pickups that can be dropped by killed enemies. Collecting enough experience allows the player to level up. The amount of experience gained is affected by the Growth stat.
pickups.effects: Gives 50 XP (as a light source drop).
pickups.notes:
* Amount depends on gem type.
* Amount of XP gained is multiplied by Growth.

pickups.name: Floor Chicken
pickups.caption: Restores 30 Health points.
pickups.description:
The Floor Chicken is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources. It restores 30 Health to the player upon being picked up, and its drop rate depends on the Luck stat.
Collecting five Floor Chickens will unlock the Garlic.
Collecting 500 Floor Chickens will unlock The Coop stage.
Floor Chicken can also be gained upon level up in the late game. It is offered as a choice when your inventory is full and all items are maxed out.
pickups.effects: Heals 30 HP.
pickups.notes:
* Available as an option for leveling up after all weapons and passive items are maxed.
* Increases Gatti Amari's effectiveness.
* Healing is doubled with Sarabande of Healing active.

pickups.name: Friendship Amulet
pickups.caption: Every player gets a level up for one of their existing weapons.
pickups.description:
Friendship Amulet is a special item exclusive to Co-op mode, that gives all players in a co-op stage a level-up for one of their equipped weapons.
Players in a co-op stage may choose the Friendship Amulet as a random choice after leveling up, starting at level 30, and it may continue to appear in subsequent level-up choices even if one of the players has previously selected it. It disappears from the level-up selection after all players reach the maximum level on all of their weapons, even if Limit Break is enabled in the run.
Friendship Amulet is unlocked by default.
pickups.effects: Gives a level up to all players for a random weapon in their inventory in a co-op mode game.
pickups.notes:
* Exclusive to Co-op mode.
* Is a hidden item which doesn't appear from light sources.
* May be offered as an option when leveling up to level 30 or above. For this purpose, it has a rarity weighting of 30.
* Disappears from level-up choices after all players' weapons have been maxed out, even if Limit Break is enabled.

pickups.name: Gilded Clover
pickups.caption: Gathers all Gold left on the ground and starts a Gold Fever.
pickups.description: Gilded Clover is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources.
pickups.effects: Collects all Gold Pickups on screen and starts a Gold Fever.
pickups.notes: * Collecting Gold Coins, Coin Bags and Rich Coin Bags increase the duration of Gold Fever.

pickups.name: Gold Coin
pickups.caption: Adds 1 to your Gold coins total.
pickups.description:
Gold Coin is an pickup that increases your Gold Coin total by 1, multiplied by the Greed stat. It is the most common drop from light sources.
Gold Coins are also the form of currency in the game.
pickups.effects: Gives 1 Coin.
pickups.notes: * Amount of coins gained is multiplied by Greed.

pickups.name: Gold Finger
pickups.caption: Gives temporary invulnerability, bonus Charm, and minimum Cooldown. Defeat as many enemies as possible to win a prize.
pickups.description:
Gold Finger is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors. It starts out exclusive to Astral Stair. After Trisection is obtained, Gold Fingers become available in all stages. It is also the rarest drop from destroyed light sources.
Picking up 5 Gold Fingers will unlock the Space 54 stage.
pickups.effects: Grants the player invincibility, Cooldown, and Charm bonuses for 14 seconds before dropping a prize based on defeated enemies.
pickups.notes: * Only available in Astral Stair until Trisection is obtained.

pickups.name: Gold Pile
pickups.caption: Adds a lot to your Gold coins total.
pickups.description: Gold Pile is a item pickup in Vampire Survivors.
pickups.effects: +1000 coins

pickups.name: Golden Egg
pickups.caption: Permanently improves a random stat for the current character, by a tiny amount.
pickups.description: The Golden Egg is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that permanently increases a random stat of the player's current character by a small amount.
pickups.effects: Permanently increases a random stat.
pickups.notes: * Drops from certain enemies including The Reaper after obtaining the Yellow Sign.

pickups.name: Lavatrix Machina
pickups.description: Lavatrix Machina is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources after Penshin Fatcha has been evolved the first time. It can only drop after the character reaches level 12, and its drop rate is affected by Luck. It is an improved version of Vacuum.
pickups.effects: All pickups, light sources, and stage items are pulled to the player. Spins enemies around the screen.
pickups.notes: * It takes time for all pickups to reach the player.

pickups.name: Little Clover
pickups.caption: Pick up to get 10% luckier.
pickups.description:
The Little Clover is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources.
Collecting the Little Clover for the first time will unlock the Clover.
Collecting 23 Little Clovers will unlock Westwoods as well as Hyper Westwoods.
pickups.effects: Gives +10% Luck.
pickups.notes: * Not related to Clover, can collect an infinite amount of them.

pickups.name: Little Heart
pickups.caption: Pick up to recover 1 HP.
pickups.description:
The Little Heart is a pickup in Vampire Survivors. It is generated by:
*Soul Eater
*Celestial Dusting
*Silver Wind and Festive Winds
*Night Sword and Muramasa
*Je-Ne-Viv's World Eater ability
It is collected automatically and heals 1 HP. Its healing is doubled with Sarabande of Healing (VI) active.
pickups.effects: Heals 1 HP.

pickups.name: Nduja Fritta Tanto
pickups.caption: Temporarily emits cones of flames. Affected by player stats.
pickups.effects: The player breathes fire in the faced direction for 10 seconds.

pickups.name: Orologion
pickups.caption: Freezes all enemies in time for 10 seconds.
pickups.description:
Orologion is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources. It can only drop after the character reaches level 4, and its drop rate is affected by Luck.
Collecting Orologion for the first time will unlock Clock Lancet.
Collecting 20 Orologions will unlock the Whiteout stage.
pickups.effects: All enemies are frozen for 10 seconds, unable to move and damage the player.
pickups.notes:
*Some enemies are resistant to being frozen.
*Can be "evolved" into Starry Heavens with Celestial Voulge.

pickups.name: Pie
pickups.description:
Pie is a pickup item in Vampire Survivors. A trail of Pies is spawned in Mad Forest after collecting Skull O'Maniac and Pummarola, which leads to the secret boss's location.
It is also dropped by Sammy the Caterpillar, flavored as birthday cakes.
pickups.effects: Heals 30 HP.

pickups.name: Rerollo
pickups.caption: Pick up to get +1 Reroll.
pickups.description:
The Rerollo is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources.
Hail from the Future (X) has a chance of dropping a Rerollo with each Level Up.
pickups.effects: Grants the player an additional Reroll.

pickups.name: Rich Coin Bag
pickups.caption: Adds 100 to your Gold coins total.
pickups.description:
Rich Coin Bag is an item pickup that increases your Gold Coin total by 100, multiplied by the Greed stat. It can drop from light sources after your character reaches level 5 in a run. Its drop rate depends on the Luck stat.
It can trigger a Gold Fever when Disco of Gold (XV) is selected.
pickups.effects: Gives 100 Coins.
pickups.notes:
* Amount of coins gained is multiplied by Greed.
* Triggers Gold Fever with Disco of Gold active.

pickups.name: Rosary
pickups.caption: Destroys all enemies in sight.
pickups.description:
The Rosary is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources. It can only drop after the character reaches level 8, and its drop rate is affected by Luck.
Collecting the Rosary for the first time unlocks the Cross.
Picking up 33 Rosaries will unlock the Laborratory stage.
pickups.effects: Kills all enemies that are not immune to it.
pickups.notes:
* Some enemies are resistant or immune to Rosary.
* Can be "evolved" into Weird Souls Purifier with Seraphic Cry.

pickups.name: Scorched Soul
pickups.caption: Pick up to get a minor bonus to MaxHealth and Might.
pickups.description:
The Scorched Soul is a pickup item in Vampire Survivors. It is dropped by defeating enemies using Fire damage while Heir of Fate (XIX) is active.
The stat bonuses provided by a Scorched Soul are based on the Base XP value of the enemy that dropped it:
** Max Health = 0.1 * Base XP Value
** Might = 0.01% * Base XP Value
*For example, a Skelegem, with a Base XP of 3, will drop a Scorched Soul that gives +0.3 Max Health and +0.03% Might.
pickups.effects: Increases Max Health and Might by a minuscule amount, which is multiplied by the Base XP value of the enemy that dropped it.

pickups.name: Sorbetto
pickups.caption: Temporarily emits freezing cones. Affected by player stats.
pickups.effects: The player breathes ice in the faced direction for 10 seconds, freezing enemies.
pickups.notes: * Only found in special places and generated by Arcana XII - Out of Bounds.

pickups.name: Starry Heavens
pickups.description: Starry Heavens is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources after evolving Glass Fandango into Celestial Voulge. It can only drop after the character reaches level 4, and its drop rate is affected by Luck. It is an improved version of Orologion.
pickups.effects: All enemies are frozen for 10 seconds and take damage periodically, unable to damage the player. They still move towards the player.
pickups.notes: * Some enemies are resistant to being frozen.

pickups.name: Treasure Chest
pickups.caption: Awards coins and Power ups. Dropped by strong enemies.
pickups.description: Treasure Chests are items that can be dropped by bosses. They can contain a number of things, including weapons, passive items, coins, and, if the conditions are met, evolutions.
pickups.effects: Gives coins, and levels up or evolves weapons. A purple chest offers an Arcana instead.
pickups.notes:
* Drops from bosses, not from light sources. Doesn't get attracted to the player.
* Only the quality of the chest is affected by Luck.
* Grants an upgrade to 1, 3 or 5 owned weapons and passive items, depending on the tier of the chest.
* Amount of coins gained is multiplied by Greed.

pickups.name: Vacuum
pickups.caption: Gathers all Experience Gems left on the ground.
pickups.description:
The Vacuum is a item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources. It can only drop after the character reaches level 12, and its drop rate is affected by Luck.
Collecting the Vacuum for the first time will unlock the Attractorb.
Picking up 50 Vacuums will unlock the The Lycaeum stage.
pickups.effects: All Experience Gems are pulled to the player.
pickups.notes:
* Ignores all pickups.
* It takes time for all gems to reach the player.
* Can be "evolved" into Lavatrix Machina with an evolved Penshin Fatcha.

pickups.name: Weird Souls Purifier
pickups.description: Weird Souls Purifier is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors that has a chance to drop from light sources after evolving Santa Javelin into Seraphic Cry. It can only drop after the character reaches level 8, and its drop rate is affected by Luck. It is an improved version of Rosary.
pickups.effects: Kills all enemies that are not immune to it.
pickups.notes: * Some enemies are resistant or immune to Weird Souls Purifier.

pickups.name: Heart Refresh
pickups.caption: Temporarily gives +5 Recovery.
pickups.description:
The Heart Refresh is an item pickup from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in Vampire Survivors. The Heart Refresh increases Recovery by +5.0 for a duration of 10 seconds, which stacks with other picked-up Heart Refreshes.
Heart Refreshes are permanently unlocked upon collecting the Stallion Gate, which is dropped by defeating the Giant Bat in the Ode to Castlevania stage. Once unlocked, they only appear in the Ode to Castlevania stage or while playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in any other stage.
Additionally, picking up a total of 7 Heart Refreshes or more unlocks Sonia Belmont as a playable character.
pickups.effects: Gives +5 Recovery for 10 seconds. This effect stacks.
pickups.notes: * Can only appear when playing on Ode to Castlevania, or when playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC.

pickups.name: Karma Coin
pickups.caption: Has a 50% chance to trigger a Soul Steal, which destroys all enemies in line of sight and turns them into hearts.
pickups.description:
The Karma Coin is an item pickup from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in Vampire Survivors.
Upon being picked up, the Karma Coin causes the character to create a speech bubble that displays "heads" or "tails". If the character says "tails", then nothing happens, but if they say "heads", following a short delay, all enemies on the screen are killed instantly and turned into Little Hearts , an effect similar to that of the Soul Steal. The Karma Coin's success rate is 50%, which can be increased by the Luck stat.
Karma Coins are permanently unlocked upon collecting the Scorpion Gate, which is dropped by defeating the Puppet Master in the Ode to Castlevania stage. Once unlocked, they only appear in the Ode to Castlevania stage or while playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in any other stage.
Additionally, picking up a total of 7 Karma Coins or more unlocks Hector as a playable character.
pickups.effects: Has a 50% chance to activate a Soul Steal, or do nothing.
pickups.notes: * Can only appear when playing on Ode to Castlevania, or when playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC.

pickups.name: Mirror of Truth
pickups.caption: Temporarily doubles Amount. Activates all equipped weapons at once when picked up.
pickups.description:
The Mirror of Truth is an item pickup from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in Vampire Survivors.
The Mirror of Truth temporarily multiplies Amount by 2× and activates all of the character's weapons for a duration of about 10 seconds, which stacks with other picked-up Mirrors of Truth.
Mirrors of Truth are permanently unlocked upon collecting the Capra Gate, which is dropped by defeating Paranoia in the Ode to Castlevania stage. Once unlocked, they only appear in the Ode to Castlevania stage or while playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in any other stage.
Additionally, picking up a total of 7 Mirrors of Truth or more unlocks Charlotte Aulin as a playable character.
pickups.effects: Doubles Amount and activates all the character's weapons for a short duration.
pickups.notes: * Can only appear when playing on Ode to Castlevania, or when playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC.

pickups.name: Neutron Bomb
pickups.caption: Deals high damage in a large area.
pickups.description:
The Neutron Bomb is an item pickup from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in Vampire Survivors.
The Neutron Bomb creates a large circular blue explosion that starts at the center and moves outward dealing a flat 1,000 damage to all enemies hit, which is unaffected by any stats. It functions identically to a level 1 Troll Bomb.
Neutron Bombs are permanently unlocked upon collecting the King's Gate, which is dropped by defeating Abaddon in the Ode to Castlevania stage. Once unlocked, they only appear in the Ode to Castlevania stage or while playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in any other stage.
pickups.effects: Deals 1000 damage to all enemies in a blast wave that moves outward from the center of the screen.
pickups.notes:
* Can only appear when playing on Ode to Castlevania, or when playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC.
* Not affected by stats.

pickups.name: Wall Chicken
pickups.caption: Typical Castlevania pot roast. Restores 60 Health points.
pickups.description: Wall Chicken is an item pickup from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in Vampire Survivors that restores 60 Health. It can drop from destroyed light sources. Its drop rate depends on the Luck stat. They only appear in Ode to Castlevania (stage) or while playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in any other stage.
pickups.effects: Heals 60 HP.
pickups.notes: * Can only appear when playing on Ode to Castlevania, or when playing as a character from the Ode to Castlevania DLC.

pickups.name: Barrier
pickups.caption: Prevents damage from the next incoming attack (max 10 stacks).
pickups.description:
Barrier is one of the pickups that has a chance to drop from light sources. Its drop rate is affected by Luck.
Barrier can only appear when playing in Neo Galuga or Hectic Highway, or as a character from the Operation Guns DLC. Simondo Belmont is also able to spawn this pickup without the need for light sources.
pickups.effects: Provides a stacking shield that prevents damage form the next attack.
pickups.notes: * Can only appear when playing on Neo Galuga or Hectic Highway, or when playing as a character from the Operation Guns DLC.

pickups.name: Grenade
pickups.caption: Deals high damage to all visible enemies.
pickups.description:
Grenade is one of the pickups that has a chance to drop from Light sources. Its drop rate is affected by Luck.
Grenade can only appear when playing on Neo Galuga or Hectic Highway, or as a character from the Operation Guns DLC. Simondo Belmont is also able to spawn this pickup without the need for light sources.
pickups.effects: Deals 1000 damage to all visible enemies.
pickups.notes:
* Can only appear when playing on Neo Galuga or Hectic Highway, or when playing as a character from the Operation Guns DLC.
* Not affected by stats.

pickups.name: Rapid Fire
pickups.caption: Temporarily gives +30% Speed and -30% Cooldown.
pickups.description:
Rapid Fire is one of the pickups that has a chance to drop from light sources. Its drop rate is affected by Luck.
Rapid Fire can only appear when playing in Neo Galuga or Hectic Highway, or as a character from the Operation Guns DLC. Simondo Belmont is also able to spawn this pickup without the need for light sources.
pickups.effects: Gives +30% Speed and -30% Cooldown for 10 seconds. Speed has no upper limit, but Cooldown is limited to -90%.
pickups.notes:
* Can only appear when playing on Neo Galuga or Hectic Highway, or when playing as a character from the Operation Guns DLC.
* Not affected by stats.
